Container.Name: Icecast
Container.Overview:
Icecast for Mopidy http stream
setup mopidy audio docker: mopidy.conf
[audio] output = lamemp3enc ! shout2send async=false mount=mopidy ip=XX.XX.XX.XX port=8000 password=hackme
NOTE: Please download the icecast.xml and void.mp3 from https://github.com/maschhoff/docker/tree/master/icecast and change username and password etc. there
